Lushai belongs to the hill country between the Bengal plains and the valleys of northeastern India and western Myanmar. Steep ridges and forested slopes supported communities whose cultivation and movement followed seasonal conditions. Shifting cultivation allowed households to use different plots over time, while hunting, gathering, and exchange supplied additional resources. Villages were centres of social life, organized through chiefs, kinship, cooperation, and customary obligations.

The wider Zo hill world contained distinct groups and languages linked across later administrative boundaries. A Mizoram government study describes successive migrations into the Lushai Hills during the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, although the early chronology remains uncertain. Village leadership became hereditary over time, creating a political landscape of numerous local chiefships. Trade and contact with neighbouring lowlands brought goods and information as well as conflict.
simp_chinese:
卢夏属于孟加拉平原与印度东北、缅甸西部河谷之间的山地。陡峭山脊和森林坡地支撑着随季节耕作与迁移的社群。轮耕使家庭能够在不同时期使用不同地块，狩猎、采集和交换提供补充资源。村落是社会生活的重要中心，通过首领、亲属关系、合作及习俗义务组织起来。

更广阔的佐人山地有不同的群体和语言，其联系跨越了后来划定的行政边界。米佐拉姆政府的一项研究记述，十七、十八世纪不同群体陆续迁入卢夏山区，但早期年代仍不确定。村落首领职位逐渐世袭，形成众多地方首领并存的政治格局。与邻近低地的贸易带来货物和消息，交往也可能涉及冲突。

sources.title: 1740657927 12-Their Strengthening and updating in Mizoram Web.pdf

english: Lushan lies east of the Funiu Mountains, in a district known for its old ceramic kilns. At Duandian, potters began firing wares in the Tang and became celebrated for dark glazes marked with pale splashes of colour. They made vessels as well as ceramic drums, fragments of which have been found at the kiln site. Production continued through the Song and Jin, with a wider range of glazes and styles; pottery remains from the Yuan and Ming are also found in the kiln area.
simp_chinese: 鲁山位于伏牛山东麓，境内古窑历史悠久。段店窑自唐代开始烧造，以黑釉上点缀浅色斑纹的花瓷闻名；窑址出土了器皿和瓷腰鼓的残片。宋金时期，窑场生产的釉色与器物样式更加丰富，遗址中也发现了元、明时期的瓷片。

english: Lushan lies in the mountains northwest of Yazhou, where forested valleys open towards the Sichuan Basin. The district was home to Fan Min, an official of the Eastern Han whose tomb monuments preserve inscriptions and carved stonework. His memorial gateway and stone beasts stand among the traces of a long history of settlement in a region of high ridges, abundant rain and wooded slopes.
simp_chinese: 卢山位于雅州西北的山区，林木覆盖的谷地朝四川盆地敞开。这里是东汉官员樊敏的故乡，他的墓前碑阙和石兽保存着古代题刻与雕刻。高岭、多雨和森林环绕的这片地区，留下了漫长的人居历史。

english: Lushi stands in a mountain valley on the Luo River in western Henan. Its City God Temple, first built near the end of the Yuan, was repeatedly damaged and restored. Warfare struck it in the Xuande reign; rebuilding followed in 1464–1466, and another fire in 1550 brought a further reconstruction. Under the Qing its gates and halls received glazed tiles and colourful roof ornaments. Across the river, ferries carried people between the town and the southern bank.
simp_chinese: 卢氏位于豫西山间的洛河谷地。县城的城隍庙始建于元末，此后屡毁屡修：宣德年间遭兵火，1464年至1466年重建，1550年又遇火灾，再次修复。清代修缮时，门楼和殿宇添上琉璃瓦与彩色屋脊装饰。洛河两岸往来则有渡船接送行人。

english:
Lusignan in Poitou grew beneath the castle of the Lusignan family, whose members acquired crowns in the eastern Mediterranean during the crusading era. The stronghold and the family are associated with the legend of Mélusine. Its position above the Vonne made the castle a prominent feature of the town.

During the French Wars of Religion Protestant forces occupied Lusignan in 1569, although they were obliged to surrender it later that year. In 1574 the Duke of Montpensier besieged the town and castle; the garrison capitulated in January 1575. The castle was subsequently dismantled, and the town's fortunes increasingly rested on its position along the route between Paris and La Rochelle.
simp_chinese:
普瓦图的吕西尼昂在吕西尼昂家族的城堡下发展起来；该家族成员在十字军时代获得东地中海的王位。城堡和家族与梅露莘传说相联系，城堡居高临沃讷河，是城镇的重要地标。

法国宗教战争期间，新教军队于1569年占领吕西尼昂，但同年稍后被迫交还。1574年蒙庞西耶公爵围攻城镇和城堡，守军于1575年1月投降。城堡随后被拆毁，城镇日后的发展越来越依靠其在巴黎至拉罗谢尔道路上的位置。

english: Lusongui lies in the high country near the Luvua, between Lake Mweru and the Lualaba. The Hemba inhabited the western part of the region bounded by the Luvua, Lukuga and Lualaba rivers. Before 1810, a son of the Luba ruler Ilunga Sungu established the client kingdom of Kyombo Mkubwa in the country between the Luvua and Lukuga.
simp_chinese: 卢松吉位于卢武阿河附近的高地，处在姆韦鲁湖和卢阿拉巴河之间。亨巴人居住在卢武阿河、卢库加河和卢阿拉巴河所围地区的西部。1810年以前，卢巴统治者伊隆加·松古的一位儿子在卢武阿河与卢库加河之间建立了附属的基翁博·姆库布瓦王国。

english: Lussuna lies near Malela in the country west of the Lualaba, within the great network of rivers and forests of the central Congo. The surrounding region is home to Tetela and Kusu communities, whose related speech forms part of a wider linguistic landscape extending towards the Lomami. The Lualaba itself flows northward through the interior, receiving tributaries from the lands on either side.
simp_chinese: 卢苏纳位于卢阿拉巴河以西、马莱拉附近，处在刚果中部辽阔的河流与森林之间。周围地区有泰泰拉人与库苏人居住，他们的语言与更广阔的洛马米地区方言相联系。卢阿拉巴河穿过内陆向北流去，接纳两岸土地上的支流。

english:
Lusta lies on Crimea's southern coast, beneath the mountain passes that lead toward the interior. Its fortress, Aluston, was founded under the Byzantine emperor Justinian in the sixth century. A small fortified town grew beside the sea, and the walls were rebuilt by successive rulers as control of the coast changed hands.

The Genoese governed Lusta from 1381 until 1475, when the Ottomans took the town. In the 1420s a second defensive line was added, and in the 1460s the outer walls were rebuilt and strengthened with towers. Under Ottoman rule the fortress was destroyed and the settlement became a village. In 1774 fighting near Alushta during the Russo-Ottoman War left the Russian officer Mikhail Kutuzov gravely wounded; the village passed to the Crimean Khanate and then to Russia in 1783.
simp_chinese:
卢斯塔位于克里米亚南岸，背靠通往内陆的山口。六世纪，拜占庭皇帝查士丁尼在此建立阿卢斯顿要塞。海边逐渐发展出一座小型设防城镇，随着海岸的统治权屡次易手，历代统治者重修了它的城墙。

热那亚人从1381年统治卢斯塔，直到1475年奥斯曼人夺取此地。十五世纪二十年代，城镇增建了第二道防线；六十年代，外墙又得到重建，并以塔楼加强。奥斯曼统治时期，要塞被毁，聚落成为村庄。1774年，俄奥战争的战斗发生在阿卢什塔附近，俄军军官米哈伊尔·库图佐夫身受重伤；村庄随后归克里米亚汗国，1783年又落入俄罗斯手中。

english: Lutai stands among the reed marshes on the lower Jiyun River, a short distance from the Bohai shore. After the wars that ended the Tang scattered the salt-boiling households of this coast, the Later Tang governor of Youzhou, Zhao Dejun, set up the Lutai salt yard in 925, a station that fed the salt trade of the northern plain for centuries. When the Yuan placed the Changlu Salt Transport Commission over the coast, Lutai was one of the yards under it; the Ming kept the arrangement, with twenty-four yards on the Changlu coast. Salt households boiled brine here and boats carried the product up the rivers toward the capital and the interior.
simp_chinese: 芦台地处蓟运河下游的芦苇荡之间，离渤海岸不远。唐末五代战乱使这一带的灶户四散，后唐同光三年（925年），幽州节度使赵德钧在此设立芦台场，专管海盐产销，此后北方平原的食盐供应长期倚赖这类盐场。元代设长芦都转运盐使司管辖沿海盐场，芦台是其下的盐场之一；明代沿袭旧制，长芦盐区共有二十四处盐场。灶户在此煮卤成盐，成品再由船只沿河道运往京师和内地。

english: Lutang was a frontier fort north of Jingyuan, beyond the Yellow River in the dry country leading toward Ningxia. Before the fort was built, the land was used as pasture by a Mongol group. In 1599 the Ming established Lutang Fort, stationed more than a thousand soldiers and placed an officer in command. A line of frontier wall and numerous guarded passes extended from the fort; a smaller fort stood to the east. Together they controlled routes across the exposed country beyond the river.
simp_chinese: 卢塘是靖远以北黄河外的边堡，地处通往宁夏的干燥地带。筑堡之前，这里是蒙古部众的牧地。明万历二十七年（1599）建卢塘堡，设参将，驻兵千余；堡外边墙与多个隘口构成防线，东面另有小卢塘堡，共同控制黄河以外的道路。

english: Lutava was a fortified town on a promontory beside the Desna, south of Chernihiv. The river bends around the site, while a smaller stream adds to its natural defences. The Hypatian Chronicle mentions Lutava in 1155, 1159 and 1175 in connection with peace negotiations and meetings of the Olgovichi princes of Chernihiv and Severia. Earthworks and remains of the inner fort and outer settlement mark the old town.
simp_chinese: 卢塔瓦曾是切尔尼戈夫以南、杰斯纳河畔岬角上的一座设防城镇。河流环绕遗址弯曲而过，一条小溪又增添了天然防御。《伊帕季编年史》在1155年、1159年和1175年提到卢塔瓦，与切尔尼戈夫及谢韦里亚的奥列戈维奇诸侯议和、会面有关。土垒、内堡和外城遗迹标示着这座古城的位置。

english: Luthigh is an Aboriginal language traditionally spoken in the Ducie River catchment of western Cape York Peninsula. It belongs to a cluster of closely related languages and dialects, including Mpalitjanh. River country and the adjoining Gulf coast form part of the homeland of the people who spoke these languages.
simp_chinese: 卢蒂格语是约克角半岛西部杜西河流域传统使用的原住民语言。它属于一组关系密切的语言和方言，其中包括姆帕利贾恩语。河流地区及邻近的海湾海岸构成这些语言使用者家园的一部分。

english: Lùtóudiàn lies in the country around Zǎoyáng, on the routes between northern and southern Húběi. An old account recalls an official post station here, with the name Dàfù carved above its street during the Qiánlóng reign. Messengers travelling the road could find a place to stop in this settlement amid the fields and low hills.
simp_chinese: 鹿头店位于枣阳一带，处于湖北南北往来的道路上。地方记载相传这里曾设驿站，乾隆年间街头尚存“大阜驿”字样，并有驿丞管理。田野与低丘间的聚落因此成为行旅驻足之处。

english: Łutselk'e lies near the mouth of the Snowdrift River on the southern shore of Great Slave Lake's eastern arm. Its Dene name means the place of the łútsël, a small fish found in these waters. The surrounding country is part of Thaidene Nëné, the land of the ancestors, where generations of Dene have travelled and lived. Forest, rocky shores and the lake's long arms meet here at the edge of the northern interior.
simp_chinese: 卢策尔克位于大奴湖东臂南岸，靠近斯诺德里夫特河口。德内语名称意为“卢策尔鱼所在之处”，这种小鱼生活在当地水域。周围土地属于泰德内内内，即祖先之地，德内人在此世代生活、旅行。森林、岩石湖岸和湖泊狭长的支湾，在北方内陆的边缘交会。

english:
Lutsk stands on the Styr River in Volhynia. It grew in importance under Prince Liubart in the fourteenth century, when its castle was a centre of princely authority. In 1429, during the rule of Vytautas, rulers including King Władysław Jagiełło and Sigismund of Luxembourg met at Lutsk to discuss matters including defence against the Ottomans and Vytautas's proposed coronation. The town received Magdeburg law in 1432.

After the Union of Lublin in 1569, Lutsk passed to the Polish Crown and became the centre of the Volhynian voivodeship. Its churches and monasteries served several communities, and the city remained a major centre of crafts and commerce. Wars and fires contributed to decline in the later seventeenth and eighteenth centuries.
simp_chinese:
卢茨克位于沃里尼亚的斯特里河畔。14世纪柳巴尔特公爵统治时，城镇地位上升，城堡成为公爵权力中心。1429年维陶塔斯执政期间，波兰国王瓦迪斯瓦夫·雅盖沃、卢森堡的西吉斯蒙德等统治者在卢茨克会晤，讨论抵御奥斯曼及维陶塔斯拟议加冕等问题。1432年城镇获得马格德堡法。

1569年卢布林联合后，卢茨克转属波兰王冠，成为沃里尼亚省的中心。教堂与修道院服务不同社群，城市仍是重要的手工业和贸易中心。17世纪后半叶至18世纪，战争与火灾促成其衰落。

english: Luujärvi, known in Russian as Lovozero, is a Sámi settlement by the Virma near Lake Lovozero in the interior of the Kola Peninsula. Records mention the Lovozero siida in 1574 and the settlement again in 1608. Its Sámi name refers to a community by the lake. The surrounding lakes, rivers and tundra belonged to the lands of the Kildin Sámi, whose seasonal use of the interior connected fishing, hunting and reindeer herding.
simp_chinese: 卢耶尔维的俄语名为洛沃泽罗，是科拉半岛内陆、洛沃泽罗湖附近维尔马河畔的一处萨米聚落。1574年的文献提到洛沃泽罗西达，1608年又记载了这一聚落。萨米语名称指湖边的社群。周围的湖泊、河流和苔原属于基尔丁萨米人的土地，他们随季节利用内陆地区，将捕鱼、狩猎和驯鹿饲养结合起来。

english: Luuq lies near Yeed, in the dry pasture country north of Bakool. The spring Gu rains replenish grazing and water for herds, while the dry months draw people and animals toward dependable watering places. Farther south, around Hudur and Wajid, seasonal rain also supports sorghum fields.
simp_chinese: 卢克位于耶德附近、巴库勒以北的干旱牧区。春季古雨季为牲畜补充牧草和水源；干旱月份，人和牲畜则向可靠的饮水地点移动。更靠南的胡杜尔和瓦吉德一带，季节性降雨还支持高粱种植。

english: Luwas Bay lies on New Britain, where volcanic land meets the waters of the Bismarck archipelago. Island communities inhabited these coasts long before European contact. In 1700 William Dampier sailed along New Britain and recognised the strait separating it from New Guinea.
simp_chinese: 卢瓦斯湾位于新不列颠岛，火山陆地在这里与俾斯麦群岛水域相接。与欧洲人接触之前，岛屿社群早已在这些海岸生活。1700年，威廉·丹皮尔沿新不列颠航行，辨认出将其与新几内亚隔开的海峡。

english: Luwu lies at the northern end of the Gulf of Bone, between the coast and Sulawesi's highlands. Its Bugis rulers controlled routes to the iron-producing country around Lake Matano and Rongkong. From the fourteenth to the sixteenth century, high-quality iron helped make Luwu a prominent kingdom, with coastal centres at Malangke and later Palopo. Even after its early ascendancy waned, the kingdom remained involved in the trade in damar resin and other forest products from the inland valleys.
simp_chinese: 卢武位于博内湾北端，介于海岸与苏拉威西高地之间。布吉统治者控制通往马塔诺湖和龙孔产铁地区的道路。十四至十六世纪，优质铁料帮助卢武成为显赫王国，其沿海中心先在马朗克，后来迁至帕洛波。即使早期优势衰退后，王国仍参与内陆谷地达玛树脂等林产品的贸易。

english:
Luxembourg grew on a sandstone rock above the Alzette and Pétrusse valleys, the Bock, where the counts built a castle in the tenth century and the city became seat of the county. Countess Ermesinde gave it a charter of freedom in 1244. The counts rose high: Henry VII was elected King of the Romans and crowned emperor in 1312, and his son John the Blind married the heiress of Bohemia and became King of Bohemia. About 1340, under John, new fortifications were raised around the town, and the fair that is later known as the Schueberfouer was established in the same year.

John fell at Crécy in 1346, and his son Charles IV became emperor, so that the counts of Luxembourg held the crowns of Bohemia and the Empire. In 1443 the Burgundians under Philip the Good conquered it, and the duchy passed to the Burgundian, then the Spanish and the Austrian Habsburgs, who repeatedly strengthened the fortress so that by the sixteenth century it was one of the strongest in Europe. Charles V inherited the duchy and had borne the title of Duke of Luxembourg as a child.

On 11 June 1554 lightning struck the Franciscan church, where gunpowder was stored in the attic, and the explosion set the thatched roofs of the upper town on fire, destroying a large part of it. Spain began digging 23 km of casemate tunnels in 1644. Louis XIV's army besieged the city in December 1683, and Vauban directed the assault that took it on 4 June 1684. The Treaty of Ryswick returned it to Spain in 1697, and from 1714 it was Austrian. The French revolutionary army besieged it for seven months before the garrison surrendered in 1795; Carnot called it the best fortress in the world except Gibraltar, and the city became the capital of the department of Forêts.
simp_chinese:
卢森堡城建在阿尔泽特河与佩特吕斯河谷之上的砂岩高地“博克岩”上，伯爵们在10世纪于此建造城堡，这座城市成为伯国的驻地。1244年埃尔梅辛德女伯爵授予它自由特许状。伯爵家族的地位也随之提升：亨利七世当选为罗马人国王，1312年加冕为皇帝；他的儿子盲目的约翰娶了波希米亚的继承人，成为波希米亚国王。约1340年约翰治下，城镇周围修起新的防御工事，同年还创设了后来称作舒贝尔集市的集市。

1346年约翰在克雷西阵亡，其子查理四世成为皇帝，卢森堡伯爵家族由此同时掌握波希米亚王冠和帝国皇冠。1443年勃艮第的好人菲利普征服此地，公国相继归于勃艮第、西班牙和奥地利的哈布斯堡家族，他们一再加固要塞，到16世纪卢森堡已是欧洲最坚固的要塞之一。查理五世继承了这个公国，他童年时曾拥有卢森堡公爵的头衔。

1554年6月11日，雷电击中方济各会教堂，阁楼里存放着火药，爆炸引燃了上城的茅草屋顶，毁掉了大片城区。西班牙从1644年起挖掘23公里的炮台隧道。路易十四的军队1683年12月围城，沃邦指挥进攻，于1684年6月4日攻克。1697年《赖斯韦克和约》把它还给西班牙，1714年起归奥地利。法国革命军围困七个月后，守军于1795年投降；卡诺称它为“除直布罗陀外世界上最好的要塞”，该城成为森林省的省会。

english:
Luxeuil lies at the approaches to the Vosges in eastern France, where springs and routes connect a settlement with wooded uplands and agricultural country. Its thermal waters were known long before the medieval town, giving the place a distinctive relationship with healing and travel. Farming, crafts and local markets support the surrounding district, while roads link it with the wider Franche-Comte region. Religious institutions add another major layer to its urban identity.

Saint Columban founded Luxeuil's abbey around 590. Its schools became celebrated in the Middle Ages, and its abbots wielded considerable influence. The abbey church was completed in 1330; the monastery was suppressed during the French Revolution.
simp_chinese:
吕克瑟伊位于法国东部孚日山通路，泉水和道路把聚落同森林高地及农业地区连接。温泉早于中世纪城镇便已知名，使地点同疗养和旅行具有独特关系。农业、手工业和地方市场支持周边地区，道路联系更广大弗朗什—孔泰。宗教机构又为城市身份增加重要层次。

圣科伦班约于590年创建吕克瑟伊修道院。修道院学校在中世纪享有声名，院长也具有可观影响力。修道院教堂于1330年建成，修道院则在法国大革命期间被撤销。

english: Lúxī lies on the Yuán River in western Hunan, where waterways pass between wooded mountains. Its county belonged to Chénzhōu Prefecture under the Ming and Qing. The river town of Pǔshì became a commercial centre in the district: ironworking helped its trade flourish during the Ming, and by the late Ming and early Qing merchant families had established substantial businesses there. Boats carried goods along the Yuán between the western highlands and Dòngtíng Lake.
simp_chinese: 卢溪位于湖南西部沅江沿岸，河水穿行于群山之间。明清时期卢溪县属辰州府。境内浦市逐渐成为商贸中心，明代冶铁业带动商业兴盛；明末清初已有商人家族在此经营。船只沿沅江往返，将西部高地与洞庭湖联系起来。

english: Lu County was the old name of the settlement at Tongzhou, east of Beijing and near the northern end of the Grand Canal. Under the Yuan, the Tonghui River connected the canal with the capital. The Ming stored grain arriving from the south in large granaries at Tongzhou, where cargo could be held for transfer to Beijing or reserved for troops guarding the northern frontier.
simp_chinese: 潞县是北京以东通州的旧名，位于大运河北端附近。元代开通通惠河，将运河与京城相连。明代南方漕粮运至通州，存入大批仓库，再转运北京，或留作北方边军的粮饷。

english: Luxiang was an ancient county in the low country south of Laizhou Bay. Its old walled town lay near Chengzi, between the waterways that drain toward the northern Jiaolai River. Under the Western Han, Luxiang belonged to Donglai Commandery and for a time was made a marquisate. Its neighbours included Pingdu to the north and Duchang across the river to the west. The ancient county name remained in local histories long after its administrative boundaries had changed.
simp_chinese: 卢乡是莱州湾以南低地上的古县，故城位于城子一带，附近的河流汇向北胶莱河。西汉时期，卢乡属东莱郡，一度改为侯国。它北接平度，西隔胶水与都昌相邻。此后地方区划几经变迁，卢乡旧名仍保留在地方史记述中。

english:
Luyang was the county seat of Yuanzhou on the edge of the Yunnan-Guizhou plateau, in the valley of the Wu River. The Song took the district from the Tian family, who held it as a native chiefdom called Yizhou, and in 1074 set up Luyang County and Yuanzhou in the new walled town. Under the Ming, Yuanzhou was demoted in 1376 and Luyang County abolished, the department town taking over its lands.

The Ming valued the place as the last stop in Huguang on the road from Chu through Guizhou to Yunnan. In 1548 the censor Zhang Yue, commanding Huguang, Guizhou, Sichuan and Yunnan against the Miao uprising on Mount Laer, set up his headquarters at Yuanzhou and stayed until 1563. In 1600, during the campaign against Yang Yinglong of Bozhou, the court stationed the governor of Pianyuan here. The Qing made Yuanzhou a prefecture in 1736 and added Zhijiang as its county.
simp_chinese:
卢阳是沅州的治所，位于云贵高原东缘，潕水河谷之中。此地原为南江田氏所据的羁縻州懿州，北宋熙宁七年（1074年），朝廷攻占该地后，在新城设卢阳县和沅州。明洪武九年（1376年），沅州府降为沅州，卢阳县被撤销，其地直属沅州，州城仍在原处。

明代视这里为湖广境内楚黔滇大道的最后一站。嘉靖二十七年（1548年），右都御史张岳受命总督湖广、贵州、四川、云南军务，征讨腊尔山苗民叛乱，将总督府设在沅州，直到嘉靖四十二年（1563年）才裁撤。万历二十八年（1600年），为征讨播州杨应龙，朝廷又让偏沅巡抚驻于沅州。清乾隆元年（1736年），沅州升为沅州府，另设芷江县为附郭。

english: Luyi is traditionally associated with Laozi, the ancient thinker revered as the author of the Dao De Jing and a founding figure of Daoism. East of the town, Taiqing Palace grew from a shrine to Laozi into a major religious complex. Tang emperors, who honoured him as an ancestor, bestowed titles and patronage upon the sanctuary. It was repaired again in 1579, preserving a long tradition of worship.
simp_chinese: 鹿邑在传统上被视为老子故里。老子被尊为《道德经》作者和道教的重要祖师；城东太清宫由老子祠发展为规模宏大的宫观。唐代皇帝尊其为祖先，赐予封号并支持宫观；1579年太清宫再次修缮，延续悠久的祭祀传统。

english: Luzhang stands on the western side of the Nu River, beneath the eastern slopes of the Gaoligong Mountains. Steep wooded hills descend toward the river, and streams cut their way through the valleys. The area belonged to a group of local hereditary jurisdictions along the Nu. Under the Qing, a native officer of the Cha family was stationed at Luzhang, while the Duan family of Laowo held a leading position among the chiefs of the wider Lushui country.
simp_chinese: 鲁掌位于怒江西岸、高黎贡山东麓。林木覆盖的陡坡向江谷下降，溪水穿过山间峡谷。这里属于怒江沿岸若干世袭土官辖地之一。清代，茶姓土千总驻守鲁掌；在更广阔的泸水地区，老窝段氏则是诸土官中的重要家族。

english: Lúzhōu stands on the upper Yangtze and is renowned for its strong liquor. Its distillers ferment grain in mud-lined pits, preserving the microbial life that gives successive batches their distinctive fragrance. Among the city's old fermentation pits are examples dated to 1573, the first year of the Wanli reign, a testament to a craft sustained through generations of brewers.
simp_chinese: 泸州位于长江上游，以烈酒闻名。酒师用泥窖发酵粮食，窖泥中延续的微生物为一批批酒带来独特香气。当地老窖中有建于明万历元年（1573年）的窖池，见证了世代相传的酿造技艺。

english: Forested mountains run along eastern Luzon in the Sierra Madre, separating the central plains from the Pacific coast. Rivers descend from the range through deep valleys, including the watersheds of Aurora and northern Quezon. Tropical forests cover slopes from the lowlands to higher ground and shelter many birds found only in the Philippines. The long mountain chain forms a formidable barrier between inland settlements and the exposed shores beyond it.
simp_chinese: 吕宋东部的马德雷山脉覆盖森林，将中央平原与太平洋海岸分开。河流从山脉穿过深谷流下，其中包括奥罗拉和北奎松的流域。热带森林从低地延伸到高处山坡，为许多菲律宾特有鸟类提供栖地。这条绵长山脉在内陆聚落与外侧迎风海岸之间形成了一道难以穿越的屏障。

english:
Lviv was founded under Daniel of Galicia, who named it for his son Leo; it is first mentioned in 1256, and from about 1272 it was the capital of the kingdom of Galicia-Volhynia. When Prince Yury II died in 1340, Casimir III of Poland attacked the Lviv and Przemyśl lands. In 1356 he refounded the town under Magdeburg law, moving the centre south of the old princely hill and having builders raise a Gothic walled town around a market square, mostly peopled by Germans, alongside Ruthenian, Armenian and Jewish quarters. In 1379 Lviv, on the silk road from Crimea to Germany, won the staple right, which obliged every merchant passing through to put his goods on sale there for two weeks.

In the fifteenth century Lviv was Lemberg, a city whose council recorded its decisions in German; after 1434 it was the capital of the Ruthenian Voivodeship. The Ottoman advance cut its trade, and in 1527 a fire burned the Gothic town to the ground. The Dormition Brotherhood opened a school there in the second half of the sixteenth century, and the printer Ivan Fedorov worked in the city. By 1630 some 25,000 to 30,000 people lived there, more than in any other town of the Ukrainian lands. Bohdan Khmelnytsky's Cossacks besieged it in 1648, Charles XII's army took it in 1704, and in 1772 Austria made it the capital of Galicia and Lodomeria.
simp_chinese:
利沃夫由加利奇的丹尼尔创建，以他儿子列夫的名字命名；它最早见于1256年的记载，约自1272年起成为加利奇—沃里尼亚王国的都城。1340年尤里二世公爵去世后，波兰的卡齐米日三世进攻利沃夫和普热梅希尔地区。1356年他在马格德堡法权之下重建这座城镇，把中心移到旧公爵城堡所在高地以南，由工匠围绕集市广场建起哥特式的围墙城镇，居民以德意志人为主，另有罗斯人、亚美尼亚人和犹太人的街区。1379年，位于从克里米亚通往德意志的丝绸之路上的利沃夫获得了强制堆栈权，所有途经的商人必须把货物在这里摆出销售两周。

十五世纪的利沃夫是伦贝格，市议会用德语记录决议；1434年之后它是罗斯省的首府。奥斯曼人的扩张切断了贸易，1527年一场大火把哥特式的城镇烧成平地。十六世纪后半叶，圣母安息兄弟会在城里办起学校，印刷家伊万·费奥多罗夫也在这座城市工作。到1630年，这里生活着两万五千到三万人，是乌克兰各地中最大的城镇。1648年博赫丹·赫梅利尼茨基的哥萨克围攻此城，1704年查理十二世的军队攻占此城，1772年奥地利使它成为加利西亚和洛多梅里亚的首府。

english: Lwena lies in eastern Angola, in the country of the Luena River and the people who share its name. The river joins the upper Zambezi, one of several waterways that cross the wooded plateau. Lwena communities inhabit the plains along the Zambezi's tributaries, with the Chokwe to their west and Luba to the east. Their country extends across what is now eastern Angola and neighbouring parts of central Africa.
simp_chinese: 卢韦纳位于安哥拉东部，是卢埃纳河与同名族群的地区。卢埃纳河流过林木覆盖的高原，汇入赞比西河上游。卢韦纳人的社群居住在赞比西河支流沿岸的平原上，西邻乔奎人，东近卢巴人。他们的土地横跨安哥拉东部与中非邻近地区。

english: Lyady grew around the centre of the Lyatsky #italic pogost#!, a church and tax district in Novgorod's Shelon lands. Surviving payment records from 1497–1498 list its holdings under both old Novgorodian and new landowners, reflecting the changes that followed Moscow's conquest of Novgorod. A survey of the following year describes several nearby villages, including Log and Filimonovo Zagorye. By 1571 a priest of the Transfiguration church was recorded among those who certified the district's survey.
simp_chinese: 利亚迪围绕利亚茨基教区中心发展，这一教区是诺夫哥罗德谢隆地区的宗教与税收单位。保存下来的1497年至1498年缴款记录，分别列出了旧诺夫哥罗德土地所有者和新地主的地产，反映了莫斯科征服诺夫哥罗德后的变化。次年的调查描述了附近几个村庄，包括洛格和菲利莫诺沃扎戈里耶。到1571年，签署地方调查文书的人中已出现一位主显圣容教堂的神父。

english: Lyakhavichy was known in the fifteenth century as the centre of a district in the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. In 1572 Sigismund Augustus transferred the town to Jan Hieronimowicz Chodkiewicz; his son Jan Karol replaced an older wooden castle with a bastioned stone fortress. The town and castle passed to the Sapieha family in 1635. During the Russo-Polish War, Russian troops burned the town in 1655, but a siege of the fortress failed in 1660. Swedish forces took the castle after a siege in 1706 during the Great Northern War and partly destroyed it. In 1793, the Second Partition of Poland brought Lyakhavichy under Russian rule. The town's history reflects the changing fortunes of a fortified magnate seat amid the wars and partitions of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth.
simp_chinese: 利亚哈维奇在十五世纪已是立陶宛大公国的一个地区中心。1572年，齐格蒙特·奥古斯特将城镇转交给扬·希罗尼莫维奇·霍德凯维奇；其子扬·卡罗尔以带棱堡的石砌要塞取代了旧木堡。1635年，城镇和城堡转归萨佩哈家族。俄波战争期间，俄军于1655年焚毁城镇，却在1660年围攻要塞未果。大北方战争中，瑞典军队于1706年围攻后取得城堡并将其部分摧毁。1793年第二次瓜分波兰后，利亚哈维奇归入俄罗斯帝国。这座设防贵族领地的兴衰，反映了波兰立陶宛联邦经历的战争与瓜分。

english: Lyakhovichy lies in the Lovat country south of Lake Ilmen. A charter of Prince Vsevolod granted a church district of this name, with its lands, people, forests, beehives and fishing grounds, to Novgorod’s St George monastery. The monastery’s estate was still recorded in the survey of about 1495, which listed Lyakhovichy among its villages. Its fields and woods formed part of a larger monastic holding stretching along the Lovat and its tributaries.
simp_chinese: 利亚霍维奇位于伊尔门湖以南的洛瓦季河地区。弗谢沃洛德亲王的一份敕书将同名教堂辖区连同土地、居民、森林、蜂树和渔场赠给诺夫哥罗德的圣乔治修道院。约1495年的调查仍记载着修道院的产业，利亚霍维奇被列在所属村庄之中。这里的田地与森林是沿洛瓦季河及支流分布的更大修道院领地的一部分。

english:
Near Tarnovo, Lyaskovets grew from neighboring hamlets, each gathered around its own church. To the south stood the monastery of Saints Peter and Paul, a prominent Orthodox foundation whose history was bound to that of the surrounding communities. The settlement took shape around five quarters named for their churches, as newcomers settled alongside earlier inhabitants.

Under Ottoman rule, Lyaskovets and several neighboring villages enjoyed privileges confirmed in later decrees, although local accounts suggest that these protections were not always respected in practice. The monastery was a center of an uprising against Ottoman rule in 1700, and in 1708 it received a gold-covered Gospel from Peter the Great of Russia. Near the end of the 18th century, people fleeing raids on the nearby village of Chertovets settled at the eastern edge of Lyaskovets.
simp_chinese:
利亚斯科韦茨位于特尔诺沃附近，由彼此相邻的村落发展而来，每个村落都围绕着自己的教堂。南面的圣彼得与圣保罗修道院是一处重要的东正教机构，其历史与周边居民息息相关。随着移民与原有居民比邻而居，聚落逐渐形成五个以各自教堂命名的街区。

奥斯曼统治时期，利亚斯科韦茨与附近几个村庄享有特权，后来又得到敕令确认，但当地记载表明这些保护并非总能兑现。1700年，圣彼得与圣保罗修道院成为一场反奥斯曼起义的中心；1708年，俄国沙皇彼得大帝向修道院赠送了一部镶金封面的福音书。18世纪末，附近切尔托韦茨村的居民为躲避袭扰，迁居到利亚斯科韦茨的东部。

english:
Lycksele belongs to the Ume river's inland country in northern Sweden, where Sami livelihoods and Swedish administrative expansion increasingly met during the early modern period. Rivers and forests supported fishing, hunting and seasonal movement, while reindeer-related activities used wider grazing territories. Waterways connected communities with the coast, and winter travel offered routes across frozen ground. Local knowledge remained essential to practical movement and food production.

In 1607 the Swedish crown designated Lycksele, an established Sámi winter gathering place, as a church and market site. Courts, trade and tax collection took place there, and Sámi from several river valleys were required to attend church and bury their dead at the site. In 1632 Johan Skytte founded a school intended to train Sámi boys for the clergy. These institutions formed part of Swedish administrative control and colonisation of the northern interior.
simp_chinese:
吕克瑟勒属于瑞典北部于默河内陆，近代早期萨米生计与瑞典行政扩张日益相遇。河流森林支持捕鱼、狩猎和季节移动，驯鹿相关活动利用更广草场。水道联系海岸，冬季冰面提供路线。地方知识仍对实际移动食物生产必要。

1607年，瑞典王室将原为萨米人冬季聚集地的吕克瑟勒指定为教堂和市场所在地。这里举行法庭、交易及征税，多个河谷的萨米人被要求在此参加礼拜并安葬死者。1632年，约翰·许特创办学校，计划培养萨米男孩成为神职人员。这些机构是瑞典加强北方内陆行政控制与殖民的一部分。

english: Lycoming Creek runs south through wooded hills to the West Branch of the Susquehanna. The Sheshequin Path followed the creek northward, forming part of an Indigenous route between the West Branch and the Susquehanna's northern valley. During the American Revolution the same trail carried Colonel Thomas Hartley's soldiers on a campaign in 1778. They widened its narrow course for men and horses as they advanced toward Indigenous towns along the upper river.
simp_chinese: 莱科明溪向南流过林木覆盖的山丘，汇入萨斯奎哈纳河西支流。舍舍奎因小径沿溪向北，是连接西支流与萨斯奎哈纳河北部河谷的原住民路线的一部分。美国独立战争期间，托马斯·哈特利上校于1778年率军沿此道出征，向上游的原住民城镇推进时，士兵将狭窄的小径拓宽，以便人马通过。

english:
Lyepyel lies by Lake Lyepyel and the Ulla River, between the river systems of the Dvina and Dnieper. First recorded in 1439, it was granted to the Catholic church of Vitebsk and later came under the bishopric of Vilnius. Its exposed position near Polotsk brought repeated changes of ownership during the wars between Lithuania and Muscovy.

After Muscovite forces captured Polotsk in 1563, the bishopric could no longer protect Lyepyel and gave it to King Sigismund II Augustus. Following the recovery of Polotsk, Stephen Báthory restored it to the bishopric, which sold it to Lew Sapieha in 1586. Sapieha later endowed the Bernardine nuns of Vilnius with the estate. Russian rule began in 1793, and in 1812 passing armies burned many buildings. In the 1830s the poet Jan Czeczot worked on the Berezina Canal at Lyepyel.
simp_chinese:
列佩利位于列佩利湖与乌拉河附近，处在德维纳河和第聂伯河两大水系之间。它最早见于1439年的记载，曾被赠予维捷布斯克的天主教会，后来归维尔纽斯主教区所有。靠近波洛茨克的地理位置使它在立陶宛与莫斯科的战争中屡次易手。

1563年莫斯科军队攻占波洛茨克后，主教区无力保护列佩利，便将其交给齐格蒙特二世·奥古斯特国王。波洛茨克收复后，斯特凡·巴托里将此地归还主教区；主教区又于1586年将其售予列夫·萨皮耶哈。萨皮耶哈后来将庄园捐给维尔纽斯的伯尔纳铎会修女。1793年此地归入俄罗斯；1812年过境军队焚毁了许多建筑。1830年代，诗人扬·切乔特在列佩利参与别列津纳运河工程。

english: Lyme Bay curves along the coast of Dorset and Devon, opening south into the English Channel. Around Lyme Regis, cliffs of limestone, mudstone and shale expose ancient layers rich in fossils. The small harbour at Lyme lies beneath this changing coast, where landslips and waves uncover remains from a distant sea. Fishing boats and coastal vessels have long used the bay and its sheltered places.
simp_chinese: 莱姆湾沿多塞特与德文郡海岸弯曲，向南通往英吉利海峡。莱姆里吉斯附近的石灰岩、泥岩和页岩悬崖露出富含化石的古老地层。小港口位于不断变化的海岸下方，滑坡和海浪揭开遥远古海的遗存。渔船和沿海船只长期利用海湾及其避风处。

english: Lymington stands beside its river where it reaches the Solent, opposite the Isle of Wight. A market charter granted in 1257 helped establish the town as a centre for its neighbourhood, and its fairs drew traders in goods including cheese. Along the coastal marshes, salt makers evaporated seawater and produced a commodity for markets farther afield. The salterns remained an important part of local life into the early nineteenth century.
simp_chinese: 利明顿坐落在河流注入索伦特海峡之处，与怀特岛隔海相望。1257年获得的市场特许状帮助它成为周围地区的中心，集市吸引商人交易奶酪等商品。沿海沼泽地的盐工蒸发海水制盐，供应远方市场。直到十九世纪初，盐场仍是当地生活的重要组成部分。

english: Lyngen Fjord reaches inland between the mountains of northern Troms. Its waters and shores supported coastal Sámi communities who combined fishing with the use of grazing and other resources around the fjord. Norwegian farmers, fishers and traders also lived or travelled here. In the sixteenth century the Lyngen market drew Sámi and visitors from across the northern lands, bringing together people whose routes connected the coast with the interior and the Gulf of Bothnia.
simp_chinese: 灵恩峡湾深入特罗姆斯北部群山之间。峡湾的水域和沿岸养育着海岸萨米社群，居民捕鱼，也利用周围牧地和其他资源。挪威农民、渔民及商人同样在此居住或往来。十六世纪，灵恩市场吸引萨米人和北方各地的访客，汇集了沿海岸、内陆及波的尼亚湾路线而来的不同人群。

english: Lyngngam belongs to the western Khasi Hills, where the highlands meet the Garo country. Its people speak a language related to Khasi, although their customs show connections with their Garo neighbours. Like other communities of these hills, they trace descent through women. Some clans raise memorial stones for their dead, while paths between the villages link communities on both sides of the hill frontier.
simp_chinese: 林恩甘位于卡西丘陵西部，与加罗山地相接。这里的人们使用与卡西语相关的语言，习俗则与加罗邻人有所联系。与附近其他山地社群一样，他们沿母系追溯血统；一些氏族为死者竖立纪念石。山间道路连接两侧的村落，使相邻社群保持往来。

english:
Lynn stands on the Great Ouse a few miles from the Wash, laid out from 1101 by Bishop Herbert de Losinga of Thetford, who built St Margaret's Church and authorised a Saturday market. As Bishop's Lynn it grew between the Purfleet and the Millfleet, and after the Ouse was turned into its channel in the thirteenth century the port flourished. In the fourteenth century Lynn ranked among England's most important ports, trading chiefly with the Hanseatic towns of the North Sea and the Baltic. The Trinity Guildhall was rebuilt after a fire in 1421. The Hanse House of 1475 and Marriott's Warehouse, used between the fifteenth and seventeenth centuries, are the only buildings of the Hanseatic League left in England.

Margery Kempe, who was born in Lynn around 1373, dictated her account of her visions and pilgrimages there. In 1537 the town was surrendered to the Crown by the Bishop of Norwich and became King's Lynn. In 1643 it was held for the king and besieged by Parliament's Eastern Association army before it surrendered. The Custom House was built in 1683, and George Vancouver, who was to chart the Pacific coast of North America, was born in Lynn in 1757.
simp_chinese:
林恩坐落在大乌斯河畔，离沃什湾只有几英里，自1101年起由塞特福德主教赫伯特·德·洛辛加规划，他修建了圣玛格丽特教堂，并批准设立星期六集市。作为主教林恩，它在普尔弗利特河与米尔弗利特河之间发展起来；十三世纪乌斯河改道流经此地后，港口繁荣起来。十四世纪，林恩是英格兰最重要的港口之一，贸易对象主要是北海和波罗的海的汉萨城镇。三一公会堂在1421年火灾后重建。1475年的汉萨之家和十五至十七世纪使用的马里奥特仓库，是汉萨同盟在英格兰仅存的建筑。

玛格丽·肯普约于1373年生于林恩，她在这里口述了自己的异象和朝圣经历。1537年，主教将这座城镇交还王室，改称国王林恩。1643年，它为国王据守，被议会的东部联盟军队围攻，随后投降。海关大楼建于1683年，后来测绘北美太平洋海岸的乔治·温哥华于1757年出生在林恩。

english: Lököçöön lies beside a lake of the same name in the eastern part of the Central Yakutian Lowland. This is a country of lakes and forest in the Vilyuy basin, where the long winter gives way to a short summer. The Vilyuy carries the waters of this vast northern interior eastward to the Lena.
simp_chinese: 廖科乔恩坐落在同名湖畔，位于中雅库特低地的东部。这片维柳伊河流域的土地湖泊众多，森林广布，漫长的冬季之后只有短暂的夏天。维柳伊河将这片广阔北方内陆的水流向东输送，最终汇入勒拿河。

english:
Founded as the Roman colony of #italic Lugdunum#! at the confluence of the Rhône and the Saône, Lyon was the capital of the three Gauls and the seat of the imperial mint that supplied the empire with its silver coin. After the fall of Rome it became the metropolitan see of an archbishop who claimed the primacy of all Gaul, and through the Middle Ages the city's twin valleys grew into one of the great crossroads of Western Europe. Although nominally a city of the Holy Roman Empire until 1312, when it passed under direct French royal rule, Lyon was already developing as a fair city where merchants from Italy, the Low Countries, and the Mediterranean met to settle their accounts in silk, spice, and silver.

The great fairs were founded by royal grant in 1420, when the dauphin, the future Charles VII, gave the city two free fairs a year. Driven off for a time by the marauding bands called écorcheurs, they returned in 1444 and grew to four, filling sixty days of the year. No coin changed hands while a fair lasted: merchants wrote their bargains in books and settled afterwards by bills of exchange, under the eye of the consul of the Florentine nation. Italian bankers and merchants settled in numbers, and in 1536 Francis I granted a Piedmontese merchant letters patent to weave cloth of gold, silver and silk in the city, meant to break Genoa's hold on the trade.

The Wars of Religion ended this golden age. Protestants briefly seized Lyon, a massacre of its Protestants followed the St Bartholomew's Day killings, and many foreign bankers left for good, leaving silk as the city's chief wealth. Silk also made it a city of revolts. In 1793 Lyon rose against the Convention and was crushed, purged and for a time renamed Commune-Affranchie, and once the Jacquard loom had spread through its workshops, its silk weavers, the canuts, rose in two violent revolts in 1831 and 1834.
simp_chinese:
里昂最初是罗马殖民地#italic 卢格杜努姆#!，位于罗讷河和索恩河的交汇处，曾是三个高卢行省的首府，也是向帝国供应银币的皇家铸币厂所在地。罗马衰落后，它成为一位声称拥有高卢首席地位的大主教的教区，整个中世纪期间，这座城市的两条河谷已经发展成西欧最重要的十字路口之一。尽管名义上直到1312年一直是神圣罗马帝国的城市，之后才被直接置于法国王室统治之下，里昂早已发展成为一座集市城市，来自意大利、低地国家和地中海的商人们在此用丝绸、香料和白银结算他们的账目。

1420年，王太子、后来的查理七世授予里昂每年两次免税集市，大集市由此正式确立。称作“剥皮者”的流寇横行时，集市一度停办，1444年恢复后增至每年四次，一年里有六十天在开市。集市期间不动现金：商人把成交的买卖记在账簿上，散市后在佛罗伦萨商人团体领事的主持下，用汇票结算。意大利银行家和商人大批在城中定居；1536年，弗朗索瓦一世给一位皮埃蒙特商人颁发特许状，让他在里昂织造金线、银线和丝绸织物，意在打破热那亚对这门生意的垄断。

宗教战争结束了这个黄金时代。新教徒一度夺取全城，圣巴托罗缪之夜后，里昂的新教徒也遭到屠杀，许多外国银行家一去不返，丝绸从此成了城市的主要财富。丝绸也让里昂成了一座多起义的城市。1793年里昂起兵反抗国民公会，被攻破后遭到清洗，一度改名“解放公社”；雅卡尔织机在作坊里普及之后，城中的丝织工人又在1831年和1834年两度发动激烈起义。

english: Lypova Dolyna stands where the Lypivka meets the Khorol. Its name means Linden Valley, and the settlement appeared on Guillaume Le Vasseur de Beauplan's map printed in 1647. A record from that year counted about 150 households. In the later seventeenth and eighteenth centuries the village belonged to the Myrhorod and Hadiach Cossack regiments, whose companies administered the surrounding country. By the early nineteenth century it had three churches and held fairs three times a year, drawing buyers and sellers to the river valley.
simp_chinese: 利波瓦多利纳位于利皮夫卡河与霍罗尔河交汇处，地名意为「椴树谷」。1647年印行的纪尧姆·勒瓦瑟尔·德·博普兰地图上已标出此地，同年的记载约有150户居民。十七世纪后期至十八世纪，村庄先后属于米尔霍罗德和哈佳奇哥萨克团，由其百人队管理周围地区。到十九世纪初，村中有三座教堂，每年举办三次集市，吸引买卖双方来到河谷。

english:
Lyskovo lies on the right side of the middle Volga, opposite the Makaryev monastery. Local accounts date its earliest mention to 1410. The village grew as a trading and craft centre, aided by the great fair held across the river at the monastery; a royal decree confirmed the fair's revenues for the monastery in 1641.

Lyskovo had its own markets alongside the seasonal fair. In 1691 the trade in salt and fish was moved from the fair to the Lyskovo side of the Volga. The fair itself later moved to Nizhny Novgorod in 1817, changing the commercial geography of this stretch of the river.
simp_chinese:
雷斯科沃位于伏尔加河中游右岸，与马卡里耶夫修道院隔河相望。地方记述将最早提及此地的时间定为1410年。对岸修道院的大型集市促进了村庄发展为贸易和手工业中心；1641年的沙皇敕令确认将集市收入交给修道院。

雷斯科沃在季节性集市之外也有自己的市场。1691年，盐和鱼的交易从集市转移到伏尔加河雷斯科沃一侧。1817年集市迁往下诺夫哥罗德，改变了这一河段的商业格局。

english: Lysufjord is a Norse name associated with Ameralik, one of the fjords of Greenland's Western Settlement. Its waters reach inland from the southwestern coast through a mountainous landscape. Norse farms were scattered around the Ameralik and Nuuk fjord systems, where households kept livestock and hunted to supplement their herds. The church farm of Sandnes stood in this region, one of the prominent settlements that linked the smaller farms to the religious life of medieval Greenland.
simp_chinese: 利叙峡湾是与阿梅拉利克相联系的北欧名称，属于格陵兰西部聚落的峡湾之一。水道从西南海岸穿过山地伸向内陆。北欧农场散布在阿梅拉利克和努克峡湾水系周围，家庭饲养牲畜，以狩猎补充生计。桑内斯教堂农场坐落在这一地区，是连接较小农场与中世纪格陵兰宗教生活的重要聚落之一。

sources.title: The voyages of the Norsemen to America (IA voyagesofnorseme1914hovg).pdf

english: Lysva lies in a deep valley on the river of the same name, west of the Ural range. A settlement was known here by the middle of the seventeenth century. In the second half of the eighteenth century the surrounding lands passed by inheritance from the Stroganovs to Princess Varvara Shakhovskaya. She obtained permission to build an iron foundry, and construction began in 1785. Its blast furnace produced its first iron in December 1787, around which the factory settlement continued to grow.
simp_chinese: 雷瑟瓦位于乌拉尔山脉以西同名河流切出的深谷中，十七世纪中叶这里已有人居住。十八世纪后半叶，周围土地从斯特罗加诺夫家族由瓦尔瓦拉·沙霍夫斯卡娅女公爵继承。她获得兴建铸铁厂的许可，工程于1785年开始。1787年12月，高炉产出第一批铁，厂区聚落也随之继续发展。

english:
Lysychansk stands above the Siverskyi Donets in the coal-bearing hills of the Donets basin. Its origins are tied to the opening of one of the region's earliest coal mines, at Lysychya Balka, and to the foundry established on the Luhan River to supply guns and shot for the Black Sea fleet. The mining settlement founded in 1795 marked an early stage in the industrial use of the basin's coal.

Extraction began in 1796. Coal from Lysychya Balka was sent to the Luhansk works, where fuel was needed for iron production. The name Lysychansk appeared in print in an 1829 mining journal in connection with the deposit. The pits and the settlement around them brought a new industrial presence to a region long associated with the river frontier and the steppe.
simp_chinese:
利西昌斯克坐落于北顿涅茨河上方、顿涅茨盆地的含煤丘陵中。它的起源与利西恰巴尔卡一处早期煤矿有关，也与卢甘河畔的铸造厂相连，后者为黑海舰队供应火炮和炮弹。1795年建立的矿工聚落，见证了盆地煤炭工业利用的早期阶段。

采煤于1796年开始。利西恰巴尔卡的煤被送往卢甘斯克工厂，为炼铁提供燃料。1829年，一份矿业期刊在谈及矿床时刊出了利西昌斯克这一名称。矿井与周围的聚落，为这片长期与河流边疆和草原相联系的地区带来了新的工业活动。

english: Lysye Gory was founded in 1740 as a small guard settlement by Cossacks who brought its name from a fort near Tambov. Cossacks had inhabited the surrounding country earlier: documents of the late sixteenth century record a Cossack yurt on the Balanda River. In 1745 a church dedicated to Saint Demetrius of Thessalonica was built through the efforts of Grigory Orlov. The settlement was also known as Dmitriyevskoye after its church.
simp_chinese: 雷瑟耶戈雷由哥萨克人于1740年建立，起初是一处小型守卫聚落，名字取自坦波夫附近的一座堡垒。哥萨克人此前便已居住在周边地区：十六世纪末的文书记载了巴兰达河上的一处哥萨克营地。1745年，格里戈里·奥尔洛夫促成当地建起一座供奉帖撒罗尼迦的圣德米特里的教堂，聚落也因此有了德米特里耶夫斯科耶的别名。

english:
Lyuban belongs to the forest and river country between the Novgorod lands and the approaches to the Baltic. Farming households used cultivated clearings, hay meadows and woodland resources, while fishing and local crafts supplemented production. Roads and waterways linked villages with markets, carrying food, timber products and everyday goods. Wet ground and seasonal weather could complicate transport, making winter routes and knowledge of crossings especially useful.

Lyuban appears as a village in the Novgorod land register of 1499–1500. In 1711 a postal route between St Petersburg and Moscow was established through the settlement, connecting it to the new imperial capital. Its early history thus belongs to a rural landscape that also served travellers along an increasingly important road.
simp_chinese:
柳班属于诺夫哥罗德领地与波罗的海方向之间的森林、河流地区。农户利用耕作空地、干草地和林产，捕鱼及地方工艺补充生产。道路、水道把村庄同市场连接起来，运输食物、木材制品和日用品。湿地及季节天气可能使交通困难，冬季路线和渡口知识因此特别有用，家庭需要按照条件安排劳动与储备。

柳班作为村庄见于1499至1500年的诺夫哥罗德土地登记册。1711年，圣彼得堡与莫斯科之间的邮路经过这里，将聚落与新帝国首都连接。它的早期历史属于乡村社会，也与日益重要的道路交通有关。

sources.title: 6 Материалы по обоснованию генерального плана в текстовой форме.pdf

english: Lyubashany is a rural settlement in the wooded country east of the Berezina River. Its name appears as Luboshany in a record of 1496, when the land belonged to the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. In the sixteenth century the estate figured in transactions over noble property, including a pledge recorded in 1560. Such records offer a glimpse of the local landed society that governed the villages and fields scattered across this part of White Ruthenia.
simp_chinese: 柳巴沙内位于别列津纳河以东的林地乡间。1496年的一份记载以“卢博沙内”称呼此地，当时这里属于立陶宛大公国。16世纪，这座庄园出现在贵族地产交易的文书中，其中包括1560年记录的一次抵押。这些记载让人得以窥见白鲁塞尼亚这片土地上的地方地主社会，以及散布于林地和田野间的村落。

english: Lyubcha stands on the Neman near Novogrudok, where a fortified noble residence overlooked the river. Its castle began in 1581 under Jan Kiszka, a powerful Protestant magnate. He sought to make Lyubcha a centre of learning and faith, establishing a prayer house, school and printing works. The castle later belonged to the Radziwiłł family, serving as a residence as well as a defence. In 1655 Cossack forces under Ivan Zolotarenko crossed the Neman, captured the stronghold and devastated it, bringing the wars of the seventeenth century to the banks of the river.
simp_chinese: 柳布恰位于新格鲁多克附近的涅曼河畔，一座设防的贵族府邸俯瞰着河流。1581年，势力强大的新教贵族扬·基什卡开始修建城堡。他希望将柳布恰建成宗教和学术中心，在此设立祈祷所、学校和印刷所。城堡后来属于拉齐维乌家族，既是府邸也是防御工事。1655年，伊万·佐洛塔连科率哥萨克军渡过涅曼河，攻占并严重破坏要塞，十七世纪的战火由此来到河岸。

english: Lyubichi stands on the left bank of the Oka, opposite Dednovo, where the river once marked a boundary between Ryazan and Moscow. A boundary charter associated with Prince Fyodor Vasilyevich of Ryazan names the Lyubutsky boundary in 1498. The old forms of the village's name include Lyubuchi and Lyubutsk. Its position beside the Oka placed it among the riverside communities whose lands and crossings were carefully defined by the neighbouring principalities.
simp_chinese: 柳比奇位于奥卡河左岸，与杰德诺沃隔河相望；这里的河流曾是梁赞与莫斯科之间的边界。一份与梁赞亲王费奥多尔·瓦西里耶维奇有关、约为1498年的划界文书提到柳布茨基边界。村庄的古名有柳布奇和柳布茨克等形式。它位于奥卡河畔，属于那些土地和渡口由相邻公国仔细划定的沿河社群。

english: Lyubim stands beside the Obnora, a tributary of the Kostroma River in the upper Volga basin. The settlement has been known since 1546, when the forested country north of the Volga lay within the expanding Muscovite state. It received town status in 1777. Its river setting places it within the network of tributaries that drain the country between Yaroslavl, Kostroma and Vologda.
simp_chinese: 柳比姆坐落在奥布诺拉河畔。这条河是科斯特罗马河的支流，属于伏尔加河上游水系。这个聚落自1546年起见于记载，当时伏尔加河北方的林地已处于不断扩张的莫斯科国家之内。1777年，柳比姆获得城镇地位；它所在的河流汇入众多支流构成的水系，流经雅罗斯拉夫尔、科斯特罗马和沃洛格达之间的地区。

english: Lyubno lies in the wooded lake country near Molvotitsy, between the Lovat basin and Lake Seliger. A churchyard and village shared its name, serving a rural district dotted with small settlements. Nearby Molvotitsy was a Novgorodian fortified place, known in the fifteenth century as the bishop’s town because it belonged to the household of St Sophia. These forests and waterways lay close to the contested borderlands of Novgorod, Lithuania and Moscow.
simp_chinese: 柳布诺位于莫尔沃季齐附近的森林湖泊地带，介于洛瓦季河流域和谢利格尔湖之间。同名的教堂村与村庄为散布着小聚落的乡村地区服务。附近的莫尔沃季齐曾是诺夫哥罗德设防地点，十五世纪因属于圣索菲亚主教府而被称作「主教的城镇」。这片森林水域靠近诺夫哥罗德、立陶宛与莫斯科争夺的边地。

english: Lyubun lies in the country west of Mosalsk, close to routes crossing the watershed of the Oka and Desna. The district was among the territories gained by Ivan III of Moscow in the 1503 agreement with Grand Prince Alexander of Lithuania. In the eighteenth century the village and surrounding deserted lands belonged to landowners of the Mosalsk district. Its position at a meeting of roads later made it a stopping place for goods travelling westward through the interior.
simp_chinese: 柳奔位于莫萨尔斯克以西，靠近越过奥卡河与杰斯纳河分水岭的道路。1503年，莫斯科的伊凡三世与立陶宛大公亚历山大达成协议，柳奔辖区成为莫斯科所得土地之一。十八世纪，村庄及周围荒地属于莫萨尔斯克地区的地主。道路交会的位置后来使这里成为货物穿过内陆向西运输时的中转地。

english:
At Lyubytino the Bela joins the Msta amid a remarkable concentration of old burial mounds. Tall earthen sopki rise beside the river, traces of communities that inhabited this stretch of the Msta long before the modern settlement took shape. The river valley was known in early sources as Pomostye, a district of the Novgorod lands.

Later church settlements stood near the mouth of the Bela. The churchyard on the left bank of the Msta is recorded around 1495, and in the middle of the sixteenth century the trading settlement of Bely had 34 households. Pestilence and epidemics took a heavy toll: by the end of the seventeenth century, seven households on the left bank were occupied and twenty-two stood empty. The waterways nevertheless sustained exchange in timber, flour, livestock and pottery among the communities along the Msta.
simp_chinese:
在柳贝季诺，别拉河汇入姆斯塔河，河畔分布着数量惊人的古墓丘。高大的土丘矗立水边，留下了后来的聚落形成之前姆斯塔河居民的痕迹。早期文献把这段河谷称为波莫斯季耶，它是诺夫哥罗德土地上的一个地区。

后来，别拉河口附近出现了教堂聚落。姆斯塔河左岸的教堂村约于1495年见于记录；十六世纪中叶，贸易聚落别雷有34户人家。瘟疫造成沉重损失，到十七世纪末，左岸仅有7户有人居住，另有22户空置。尽管如此，水路仍维系着姆斯塔河沿岸社区之间的木材、面粉、牲畜和陶器贸易。

english: The Ma’amtagila are a Kwakwaka’wakw people whose homeland lies around Johnstone Strait, between northern Vancouver Island and the mainland inlets. Their villages include I’tsiḵin, also known as Matilpi, and Hiladi near the Adam River. Cedar from the coastal forests provided material for carving, while hereditary chiefs upheld laws of stewardship and sharing through the potlatch. The Ma’amtagila trace their name to an ancestor, Matagila, the grey seagull.
simp_chinese: 马阿姆塔吉拉是夸夸嘉夸诸族之一，故土环绕约翰斯通海峡，横跨温哥华岛北部与大陆峡湾之间。他们的村庄包括伊特西金，又称马蒂尔皮，以及亚当河附近的希拉迪。沿海森林中的雪松为雕刻提供材料，世袭首领则通过赠礼宴会维护照管土地、分享资源的法则。马阿姆塔吉拉人的名称源自祖先马塔吉拉，即灰海鸥。

english:
Matehuala lies on the high, dry plateau north of San Luis Potosí, near the eastern edge of Guachichil country. Mountain ranges rise beyond the valley, and routes across the plateau link it with the northern mining districts. Guachichil communities occupied this frontier before and during Spanish expansion; colonial records also refer to people called Negritos in the region. Their settlements and camps formed part of a landscape of many distinct Indigenous groups.

At the end of the sixteenth century the Chichimeca War gave way to negotiations and attempts to establish new settlements. A report from 1593 described Guachichil communities living in towns but also in rancherías around Matehuala and farther east, beyond effective Spanish control. The settlement developed over time amid overlapping claims by the colonial jurisdictions of Nueva Galicia and Nuevo León. A later formal foundation took place in 1706, giving the town a new place within the expanding colonial frontier.
simp_chinese:
马特瓦拉位于圣路易斯波托西以北干燥的高原上，靠近瓜奇奇尔人土地的东缘。山脉耸立在谷地之外，穿越高原的道路将这里与北方矿区相连。西班牙扩张前后，瓜奇奇尔社群都居住在这片边疆；殖民记录也提到被称为内格里托斯的人。他们的聚落和营地属于众多不同原住民群体共同生活的地区。

十六世纪末，奇奇梅卡战争逐渐转向谈判及建立新聚落的尝试。1593年的一份报告记载，一些瓜奇奇尔人住在城镇，另一些则在马特瓦拉及更东边的营地生活，仍未受西班牙人有效控制。此后聚落逐渐发展，新加利西亚与新莱昂两个殖民辖区对这里的主张相互重叠。1706年，城镇再次举行正式奠基，成为不断扩展的殖民边疆的一部分。

english: Māʻalaea Bay opens on the southwest coast of Maui, below the low isthmus that joins the West Maui Mountains to Haleakalā. Hawaiian oral tradition remembers a village and a heiau, or temple, on a promontory above the bay. Along this stretch of Maui's shore, fishing families also grew sweet potatoes on the coastal plain.
simp_chinese: 马阿拉埃亚湾位于毛伊岛西南岸，在连接西毛伊山与哈莱阿卡拉山的低矮地峡之下。夏威夷口述传统记得，俯瞰海湾的岬角上曾有一座村落和一处称作海乌的神庙。毛伊岛这段海岸的渔户也在沿岸平原上种植甘薯。

english:
Ma'an is an oasis town on the edge of the southern Jordanian desert, long used as a stopping place by travellers between Syria and Arabia. Springs and gardens made it a welcome halt before the long journey south. Medieval geographers described a fortified settlement where travellers were received, and the pilgrimage caravan from Damascus made the oasis one of its principal places of rest and supply.

In the sixteenth century the Ottomans built a fort at Ma'an to protect the Hajj route. Its square stone walls enclosed rooms for the garrison and the services needed along the road. Pilgrims might spend two days at the oasis, resting and buying provisions before continuing into the desert. Forts and watchtowers at other points along the route formed part of the same effort to safeguard travellers and their water supplies.
simp_chinese:
马安是约旦南部荒漠边缘的一座绿洲城镇，长期是往来叙利亚和阿拉伯的旅人停靠之处。泉水与园圃使它成为南行漫长旅途前受欢迎的休息地。中世纪地理学家将这里描写为接待旅人的设防聚落，大马士革出发的朝觐商队也把绿洲作为主要休整和补给地点之一。

十六世纪，奥斯曼人在马安修筑堡垒，以保护朝觐道路。方形石墙围住驻军房舍和道路服务设施。朝觐者可以在绿洲停留两天，休息并购置物资，再继续穿越荒漠。沿路其他地点的堡垒与瞭望塔，也属于保护旅人与水源的同一防御体系。

english: The forests around Ma'an spread inland from the Gulf of Guinea toward the Ntem River. Dense evergreen and semi-evergreen trees cover much of this wet equatorial country, while swamp forests and stands of raffia palms follow the river valleys. The Ntem winds westward through the forest toward the Atlantic. Moabi, iroko and other large trees rise above a rich undergrowth, and streams cross the lowlands between the river and the coast.
simp_chinese: 马安周围的森林从几内亚湾向内陆延伸，直至恩泰姆河。湿润的赤道地带大部覆盖着茂密的常绿和半常绿树林，沼泽林与拉菲亚棕榈沿河谷生长。恩泰姆河蜿蜒穿过森林，向西流入大西洋。莫阿比树、伊罗科树等高大树木耸立在茂密的林下植被之上，溪流穿过河流与海岸之间的低地。

english: Maanaagi'iisodagish lay in the prairie and river country of the upper Missouri, where the river bends through cottonwood bottoms and open grassland. Mandan villages of earth lodges stood on the high terraces, and the people grew corn, beans and squash in the floodplain, trading the surplus with neighbouring peoples and with visiting traders. A smallpox epidemic in 1781 devastated the Missouri villages, and the Mandan survivors moved upriver to live closer to the Hidatsa. When Lewis and Clark wintered near the Mandan villages in 1804, they recorded the trade fairs that drew nations from across the plains.
simp_chinese: 马纳吉伊索达吉什位于北美内陆草原与密苏里河上游的河流地带，河水在杨树河滩与开阔草地间迂回。曼丹人的土屋村落建在高台地上，居民在洪泛平原种植玉米、豆类和南瓜，并把余粮与邻近族群及来访商人交换。1781年，天花疫情重创密苏里河沿岸各村，曼丹幸存者向上游迁移，靠近希达察人。1804年，刘易斯与克拉克在曼丹村落附近过冬，记录下吸引平原各族前来的贸易集市。

english: Maaqtsiis lies on Flores Island in Clayoquot Sound, among the islands and inlets of the Nuu-chah-nulth coast. The Ahousaht originally lived around nearby Vargas Island, facing the open sea. In the early nineteenth century they fought the Otsosaht, whose lands included Flores Island, and established their main village at Maaqtsiis. The sheltered passages of the sound connected the village to fishing grounds and to other communities along Vancouver Island’s western shore.
simp_chinese: 马阿克图西斯位于克拉阔特湾的弗洛雷斯岛，坐落在努查努尔特海岸的岛屿和水道之间。阿豪萨特人原本居住在附近的瓦尔加斯岛一带，面向开阔海洋。十九世纪初，他们与拥有弗洛雷斯岛等地的奥措萨特人交战，并在马阿克图西斯建立主要村庄。海湾内避风的水道将村庄连接至渔场和温哥华岛西岸其他社群。

english:
The Maasai are pastoralists whose society is closely connected to cattle. Herds supply milk and are a source of wealth, while families move in search of grazing across the East African plains. Social leadership is organized through age sets, with different generations holding distinct responsibilities. Women possess detailed knowledge of their animals, including their ancestry, milk yield and temperament, and play an important part in the care of herds.

The later city of Isiolo lies here.
simp_chinese:
马赛人是牧民，社会生活与牛群紧密相连。牲畜提供乳汁，也是财富的来源；家庭随牧场情况在东非平原迁移。社会领导依年龄组组织，不同世代承担不同职责。妇女熟悉牲畜的血统、产奶量和性情，在照料畜群中发挥重要作用。

后来的伊西奥洛即位于此地。

english: Maaselkä was a Sámi community of the Kola Peninsula, known in Russian as Maselga or the Pulozero pogost. It belonged to the inland Kildin Sámi country, whose settlements lay among the lakes and tundra west of Lovozero. The name of the community survived in several languages, reflecting the different peoples and administrations that recorded it. Its lands formed part of a wider network of seasonal Sámi settlements across the peninsula.
simp_chinese: 马塞尔凯是科拉半岛的萨米社群，俄语称马谢尔加或普洛泽罗波戈斯特。它属于基尔丁萨米人的内陆地区，聚落分布在洛沃泽罗以西的湖泊和苔原之间。社群名称以多种语言保存下来，反映了不同民族和行政机构对它的记录。这里的土地是半岛上萨米人季节性聚落网络的一部分。

english:
Maastricht grew at the shallow crossing of the Meuse where a Roman bridge carried the road from Bavay to Cologne, and where Saint Servatius, bishop of Tongeren, was buried in 384. The collegiate churches of Saint Servatius and Our Lady made it a centre of Mosan art and of the septennial pilgrimage that drew crowds of pilgrims, while the river sustained trade in wool and leather. In 1204 a treaty confirmed the town's unusual dual lordship under the prince-bishop of Liège and the duke of Brabant, and a ring of walls rose soon afterwards.

In 1275 the old Roman bridge collapsed under a procession, reportedly killing hundreds; a replacement financed by indulgences was built slightly to the north as the Sint Servaasbrug. Wool and leather remained the staples of its trade, and after a brief revival around 1500 the town's economy declined.

The crossing then made Maastricht a coveted fortress. In 1579 the Duke of Parma's Spanish army sacked it, and the Spanish crown replaced Brabant in the joint rule. Frederick Henry of Orange took the city in 1632, after which the Dutch States General shared sovereignty with Liège. In 1673 Louis XIV besieged it, Vauban applied his systematic siege method, and the captain-lieutenant d'Artagnan was shot dead outside the Tongerse Poort. France held the city until 1678 and returned in 1748; after each siege the fortifications were repaired and enlarged. In 1794 the French revolutionary army ended the old condominium, and Maastricht became capital of the department of Meuse-Inférieure.
simp_chinese:
马斯特里赫特兴起于默兹河的浅滩渡口，罗马桥梁在此承载巴韦通往科隆的道路，通格伦主教圣瑟法斯也于384年安葬于此。圣瑟法斯教堂与圣母教堂两座参议教堂使它成为默兹艺术的中心，也是每七年举行一次的朝圣大典的举办地，吸引大批朝圣者前来，河流则支撑着羊毛与皮革贸易。1204年，一份条约确认了此城由列日亲王主教和布拉班特公爵共同统治的特殊局面，不久之后城墙环绕了市区。

1275年，旧罗马桥在游行队伍的重压下坍塌，据说造成数百人死亡；人们靠赎罪券筹款，在稍北处另修了新桥，即圣瑟法斯桥。羊毛和皮革始终是当地贸易的大宗，1500年前后经济曾短暂复兴，随后转入衰落。

渡口也使马斯特里赫特成为备受争夺的堡垒。1579年，帕尔马公爵的西班牙军队攻陷并洗劫此城，西班牙王室取代布拉班特参与共同统治。1632年，奥兰治的腓特烈·亨德里克夺取该城，荷兰三级会议此后与列日共同治理。1673年路易十四围城，沃邦运用系统的攻城方法，近卫火枪手队长达达尼昂在通厄伦门外中弹身亡。法军占领至1678年，1748年再度攻占；每次围攻之后，城防都被修复并扩建。1794年，法国革命军结束了旧有的共同统治，马斯特里赫特成为下默兹省的首府。
